title: Strategy view tabs follow the reference chart tabs (G-17-2)
reference_behaviour: Under the leg list and the always-visible summary strip, the chart area has four tabs: Payoff Graph, P&L Table, Greeks and Strategy Chart. Nothing is hidden behind a level.
ours: REQ-007 AC-2 names eight drill-down tabs (Overview, P&L, Risk, Payoff, Legs, Greeks, Conditions, Orders) and AC-3 an Advanced-only terminal view. Rewrite at row 17 to the reference tab set; Strategy Chart is REQ-091.
